steps.say: A line of symmetry splits a shape into two halves that match.

figure.alt: A rectangle with a vertical line of symmetry.

steps.say: Fold along the line. If the halves fit on top of each other, it is a line of symmetry.
Some shapes also have a horizontal line of symmetry.

figure.alt: A rectangle with a horizontal line of symmetry.

steps.say: Letters can be symmetrical too. A has a vertical line and B has a horizontal line.

check.prompt: Which letter has a vertical line of symmetry?

options.why: F has no line of symmetry.
R has no line of symmetry.
L has no line of symmetry.

hints: A vertical line goes straight up and down.
Picture folding each letter down the middle.
Do the left and right halves match?
check.explanation: Fold T down the middle and the two halves match.

check.prompt: Does this shape have a vertical line of symmetry?

options.why: Fold it down the middle: the left and right halves match.

hints: Picture a line straight down the middle.
Fold the shape along that line.
Check if the left half matches the right half.
check.explanation: The trapezium is the same on both sides, so a vertical line down the middle is a line of symmetry.

figure.alt: A trapezium with a long bottom side and a shorter top side.
